sloka: मम पृष्ठगतौ तौ च चन्द्रसूर्याविवोदितौ ।त्वत्सकाशं महाभागे नृसिंहावागमिष्यतः ।। ५.६८.२४ ।।।।
transliteration: mama pṛṣṭhagatau tau ca candrasūryāvivoditau ।tvatsakāśaṁ mahābhāge nṛsiṁhāvāgamiṣyataḥ ।। 5.68.24 ।।।।

translations.english: 'O noble lady the lions among men, Rama and Lakshmana who resemble Sun and Moon will ascend on my back and reach here.
